title: Onboard a business
subtitle: Group, legal entity, modules and first manager – created in one step. Nexotec sets nothing commercial: VAT, bank and terms are entered by the manager.
modulesHint: The modules Nexotec licenses to this business. Without sales it is a workshop-only business.

manager.hint: The manager receives an invitation by e-mail and sets their own password.

review.nothingCommercial: The business starts as «being onboarded». VAT rate, bank account and terms stay empty until the manager enters them in Administration.

success.title: {{name}} is onboarded
success.pending: Status: being onboarded – the business becomes active once its setup is complete.
success.invited: The invitation to {{email}} has been sent; the manager is invited.
success.nextSteps: The manager sets up VAT, bank, texts and number ranges in Administration.

errors.generic: The business could not be onboarded.
errors.uidAlreadyOnboarded: A business with this UID is already onboarded.
